messages:
ashwin: anyone else seeing dashboard tile stutter after yesterday's prefetch priority rollout? large maps go choppy on first scroll
leo: yep, reproduced on prod-canary. lcp jumps and tiny sparklines freeze for ~200-300ms
maria: i grabbed a profile — main thread gets blocked when worker fallback kicks in and we start rehydrating lots of small tiles
ashwin: any stack/logs?
maria: paste logs:
```
network: GET /tiles/heatmap/region/123?z=4 200 12ms
cache: kv_cache.hit=1 key=tile:123:4
cache: kv_cache.eviction key=tile:110:4 reason=capacity
network: GET /tiles/110/4 120ms
worker: fallback->main-thread parse 210ms
```
maria: you can see an eviction burst then hammer of re-fetches
dena: runtime metrics show kv_cache.evictions spiked ~3x at 15:02 after the prefetch threshold bump (prefetch_threshold=32 -> old was 8)
leo: that's the suspicious bit. prefetch was trying to be aggressive and is trashing the tile cache for large dashboards
ashwin: can we revert the threshold or add eviction hysteresis?
dena: quick mitigation: gate prefetch by cache occupancy. pseudocode: `if (cache.occupancy > 0.75) skip_prefetch()`
ashwin: i worry occupancy check may be racy across tabs but better than nothing
alex: +1 for immediate canary tweak. also we should add an alert: `rate(kv_cache.evictions[5m]) > 30` to page the oncall
maria: small hotfix we can try: disable worker->main fallback for tiles > 200kb so we don't block main thread parsing lots of bytes
leo: that helps UX while we figure long-term tiling strategy (coarser tiles, better combine tiles)
deploy-bot: deploy finished: rollout/redwood-console@2023.11.15-canary to eu-west-1 at 15:05 UTC :rocket:
dena: i'm going to push a canary change lowering prefetch_threshold to 8 for canary only and add occupancy gate. will watch kv_cache.evictions and lcp SLI
maria: created logging PR for more telemetry (tile-size histogram + eviction reasons) https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/1234
ashwin: nice. after canary stabilize we should schedule a follow-up: longer-term: adaptive prefetch based on per-route working set + sample-based tiling decisions
leo: also note quota/routing angle: heavy prefetch from single region was crowding edge bandwidth for some tenant routes. check ingress quotas in the morning
alex: i'll file a short RFC for runbook + rollout UX (canary flags for prefetch + patch notes in console)
ashwin: cool. dena ping here when canary metrics look normal, otherwise rollback plan ready
leo: thanks folks :thumbsup:
